label: Security Audit
description: Analyze a system, implementation, or configuration for security risk.

classifier.useWhen: User asks for vulnerabilities, abuse cases, secrets, auth, permissions, or risk.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for general code quality without security focus.

label: Supply Chain Security Audit
description: Review dependencies, packages, build provenance, lockfiles, and release artifacts for supply-chain risk.

classifier.useWhen: User asks about dependency risk, package publishing, build artifacts, provenance, or release integrity.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for normal code quality review without dependency or release risk.

label: Threat Modeling
description: Identify assets, attackers, trust boundaries, threats, and mitigations.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to model risk before or during design.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks to patch an already identified bug.

label: Vulnerability Triage
description: Assess vulnerability reports, severity, exploitability, and mitigation priority.

classifier.useWhen: User provides a CVE, scanner finding, or suspected vulnerability.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for general best practices.

label: Security Policy Review
description: Review permissions, RBAC, access policy, or compliance controls.

classifier.useWhen: User asks about authz, RBAC, scopes, permissions, or policy enforcement.

label: Secrets Scan Review
description: Inspect code, config, or logs for exposed secrets and credential risks.

classifier.useWhen: User asks to check for secrets or credential exposure.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for general documentation edits.

label: Auth Review
description: Review authentication, authorization, sessions, tokens, and access flows.

classifier.useWhen: User asks about auth risk or permission behavior.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for non-security code style review.

label: Privacy Review
description: Review data collection, retention, sharing, and privacy-sensitive flows.

classifier.useWhen: User asks about privacy risk or personal data handling.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for binding legal advice.

label: Security Incident Review
description: Review suspected incidents, indicators, containment, and follow-up actions.

classifier.useWhen: User reports a potential security incident.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for ordinary uptime triage.

label: Prompt Safety Review
description: Review prompts, tools, or agent behavior for misuse and policy risk.

classifier.useWhen: User asks about AI safety, prompt abuse, or tool misuse.
classifier.doNotUseWhen: User asks for creative prompt writing only.
